deleteConfirmBody: The v{version} backup from {date} is deleted for good. You can't roll back to it afterwards.
desktopOnlyHint: Backups run through the native bridge and are only writable in the desktop build.
restoreConfirmBody: The plugin's current files, settings and data are replaced with the v{version} backup from {date}. Anything changed since then is lost.
title: Backups
